sources.title: TSFM.ai — Time Series Foundation Models
sources.snippet: What is a Time Series Foundation Model? Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are large neural networks pre-trained on billions of observations across thousands of diverse time series.

sources.title: tsfrm (The Society for Ridiculous Models) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AI & ML interests To make the most absurd and ridiculous models out there possible, and to have fun doing it.

sources.title: tsfm-ai - GitHub
sources.snippet: TSFM.ai hosts every major open-weights time-series foundation model behind one consistent inference API — so you can benchmark, compare, and ship forecasts without managing GPU infrastructure or model weights.

sources.title: Hosted Time Series Foundation Models — TSFM.ai
sources.snippet: Browse hosted time series foundation models on TSFM.ai. Compare model families, parameter counts, architecture, context length, pricing, and deployment coverage across the catalog.

sources.title: GitHub - MSMCI-lab/tsfm: Foundation Models for Time Series
sources.snippet: Public notebooks and utilities for working with Time Series Foundation Models (TSFM) The core TSFM time series models have been made available on Hugging Face -- details can be found here.
